dimensions.assessment: Affects intellectual property owners, importers, online marketplaces, express consignment operators, freight forwarders, and Customs and Border Protection personnel.
dimensions.evidence: any other appropriate party with an interest in the imported merchandise, as determined appropriate by the Commissioner.

dimensions.assessment: Adjusts evidentiary thresholds from 'suspects' to 'reasonable suspicion' and broadened data-sharing categories for imported goods.
dimensions.evidence: striking 'suspects' and inserting 'has a reasonable suspicion'

dimensions.assessment: Contains no direct federal appropriations, spending figures, or tax changes.
Amends Section 628A of the Tariff Act of 1930 to expand categories of shareable nonpublic information and eligible parties.
dimensions.evidence: Section 628A of the Tariff Act of 1930 (19 U.S.C. 1628a) is amended

dimensions.assessment: Makes permanent statutory changes to federal customs information-sharing rules nationwide.
